arguments.summary: [RCA] payment-service: payment-service has returned HTTP 500 on POST /api/v1/pay since 10:10Z
arguments.description:
# Incident report: Payment API is returning HTTP 500 in production

- **Investigation:** inv-demo-s1 (INC-1101)
- **Service:** payment-service · **Environment:** production
- **Severity:** critical · **Confidence:** 91%
- **Affected services:** payment-service, order-service

## Summary

payment-service has returned HTTP 500 on POST /api/v1/pay since 10:10Z. Release v1.8.2 lowered the database connection pool from 20 to 2 connections; the pool saturated one minute after the rollout and requests now time out waiting for a connection. Rolling back to v1.8.1 is the documented fix.

## Root cause

Database connection pool misconfiguration introduced in payment-service v1.8.2 (DB_POOL_SIZE 20 → 2) exhausts the pool; requests time out waiting for a connection and return HTTP 500. _(confidence 91%)_

### Supporting evidence

- `ev-s1-code-1` (commit, git): Commit 739d116 'tune db pool' by Jordan Lee changed DB_POOL_SIZE from "20" to "2"
- `ev-s1-k8s-1` (k8s_event, kubernetes): Deployment payment-service rolled out revision 14 at 10:08Z, change-cause 'v1.8.2: tune db pool (DB_POOL_SIZE 20 -> 2)' [link](http://localhost:3000/d/k8s-workloads/k8s-workloads?var-deployment=payment-service&from=1790589600000&to=1790591400000)
- `ev-s1-logs-1` (log, elasticsearch): New ERROR pattern 'Database connection timeout' on POST /api/v1/pay: 44 events since 10:10Z (0 in the 24 h baseline) [link](http://localhost:5601/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-09-28T10:00:00Z',to:'2026-09-28T10:30:00Z'))&_a=(index:'payment-prod-*',query:(language:kuery,query:'FROM%20payment-prod-*%20%7C%20WHERE%20level%20IN%20(%22ERROR%22%2C%22WARN%22)%20%7C%20STATS%20count%20%3D%20COUNT(*)%20BY%20pattern')))
- `ev-s1-logs-3` (log, elasticsearch): All timeout errors come from pods running v1.8.2 (302 log lines since 10:08Z, 3 pod starts); v1.8.1 pods logged none [link](http://localhost:5601/app/discover#/?_g=(time:(from:'2026-09-28T10:00:00Z',to:'2026-09-28T10:30:00Z'))&_a=(index:'payment-prod-*',query:(language:kuery,query:'FROM%20payment-prod-*%20%7C%20STATS%20count%20%3D%20COUNT(*)%2C%20starts%20%3D%20SUM(is_start)%20BY%20version')))
- `ev-s1-metrics-3` (metric, prometheus): DB connection pool saturated at 100% (2/2 active) from 10:09Z; up to 18 requests waiting [link](http://localhost:3000/d/service-overview/service-overview?var-service=payment-service&from=1790589600000&to=1790591400000&viewPanel=DB%20pool)
- `ev-s1-metrics-1` (metric, prometheus): HTTP 5xx ratio rose from 0.5% to 24.6% at 10:10Z (≈49×) [link](http://localhost:3000/d/service-overview/service-overview?var-service=payment-service&from=1790589600000&to=1790591400000&viewPanel=Error%20rate)
- `ev-s1-alerts-1` (alert, alertmanager): DatabaseConnectionPoolExhausted (critical) firing since 10:11Z: pool ≥ 95% used, requests waiting [link](http://localhost:9093/#/alerts?filter=%7Balertname%3D%22DatabaseConnectionPoolExhausted%22%7D)
- `ev-s1-knowledge-2` (doc, knowledge-base): Known issue INC-2026-031: v1.8.2 shipped DB_POOL_SIZE=2 in a commit titled 'tune db pool' [link](https://github.com/vigneshAJ1503/AI_Incident_Agents/blob/main/knowledge-base/runbooks/database-connection-pool.md#known-issues)
- `ev-s1-tickets-1` (ticket, jira): Open known issue OPS-12 'payment-service DB connection timeouts' (High): same error, suspected pool sizing [link](http://localhost:8109/browse/OPS-12)

## Impact

HTTP 500 on POST /api/v1/pay for ~25% of requests since 10:10Z; p95 latency 9.5 s (45× baseline).

## Timeline (UTC)

- 08:20:00 Commit 739d116 'tune db pool' sets DB_POOL_SIZE 20 → 2 _(code)_
- 09:55:00 Release payment-service/v1.8.2 tagged _(code)_
- 10:08:00 Deployment rolls out revision 14 (v1.8.2) _(k8s)_
- 10:09:00 DB pool saturates at 100% (2/2 active) _(metrics)_
- 10:10:07 First 'Database connection timeout' error _(logs)_
- 10:11:00 Alert DatabaseConnectionPoolExhausted fires _(alerts)_
- 10:12:00 Alert HighErrorRate fires (5xx 24.6%) _(alerts)_
- 10:30:00 Investigation started _(aiops)_

## Next steps

1. Roll back payment-service to v1.8.1 (kubectl rollout undo deployment/payment-service -n prod).
2. Revert commit 739d116 'tune db pool' in git.
3. Confirm the 5xx ratio and pool saturation return to baseline within 2–3 minutes.
4. Update OPS-12 with this RCA; add owner review for DB_POOL_* changes.

## Open questions

- Why did the change pass review without a load test in staging?
